responsibility: Implements x86 host CPU autodetection for the GCC driver, primarily for resolving -march=native and -mtune=native. This file queries CPUID leaves, decodes cache characteristics and ISA feature bits, identifies vendor/family/model-derived processor names, and returns the synthesized command-line fragment containing the chosen cpu name plus enabling or disabling -m feature options and cache parameters, so the driver can translate the current machine into explicit target options.
